parts.html: The K-28 kitchen model combines a warm brown palette with two distinct cabinet finishes. The upper cabinets feature a wood-effect decor, while the remaining fronts have a solid brown finish. This creates a layered contemporary composition: the wood-look surfaces introduce warmth and texture, while the solid-color cabinetry keeps the overall design clean and visually balanced.

The wood-effect finish is used as an accent on the upper cabinets rather than across the entire kitchen. This distinction gives K-28 its character and allows the furniture to coordinate with light walls, ceramic tile, stone-effect surfaces, and neutral interior materials.

The defining planning feature of K-28 is its U-shaped configuration. Cabinetry extends along three sides, allowing work surfaces, storage, and built-in appliances to be distributed across separate functional areas.

The kitchen has a total linear length of 4.7 meters. During custom planning, the locations of the sink, hob, refrigerator, and other appliances can be arranged according to room dimensions, service connections, and the client’s requirements. A separate kitchen island is not included in the standard configuration.

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard. The upper cabinets have a wood-effect finish, while the lower and remaining fronts feature solid brown decor. The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard, and the countertop is chipboard-based.
For practical organization, the standard K-28 specification includes a pull-out cargo storage system. It provides an additional storage option for kitchen essentials within the cabinetry.

Hinged doors use Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close, while pull-out elements are fitted with Muller telescopic runners without soft-close. Cabinet handles are included. Lift mechanisms are not part of the standard specification.

K-28 can be customized beyond its standard materials and hardware. Upon request, the kitchen can be equipped with more advanced furniture fittings, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional functional storage systems. It can also be manufactured using alternative materials, ranging from budget-friendly options to premium finishes. Cabinet fronts, countertops, and internal fittings are selected according to the client’s requirements, room layout, and project budget.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-28 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, with adjustments to cabinet runs, appliance positions, and storage arrangements. Clients can also select their preferred combination of wood-effect and solid-color finishes, countertop materials, hardware, and internal fittings.

Our services include kitchen planning, material and hardware selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and household appliances can also be selected upon request.
